title: TCE* at Qur’an QA 2022: Arabic Language Question Answering Over Holy Qur’an Using a Post-Processed Ensemble of BERT-based Models
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to extractive question answering on the Holy Qur’an. It addresses the challenges of processing sacred religious texts in Classical Arabic and evaluates performance on the QRCD (The Qur’anic Reading Comprehension Dataset).
